description: Returns the latest monthly Wire: loans transferred to or returned from special servicing, newly delinquent, moved deeper into delinquency, new appraisal reductions, liquidations with losses and special servicer updates, largest first. Use section to fetch one list. Use it for what changed this month; use distress_index for rates and trends and search_loans for a loan's current state. Comment excerpts are included only with a key.

limit.description: Items per section: default 10 without a key and 25 with one; up to 25 without a key and 400 with one
